name: The Olympic Club Cliffs
location: San Francisco (the Pacific bluffs west of Skyline Boulevard), California
architects: Jay Morrish and Tom Weiskopf (1994), Bill Love

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM (3DEPElevation exportImage), x 543500-545600 / y 4172600-4174700 EPSG:32610, NAVD88 metres, clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-olympic_club)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project CA_SanFrancisco_B23 (CA_SanFrancisco_1_B23), 11 tiles, class 1 (the tiles carry classes 1, 2, 7, 9 and 20: no vegetation classes, so trees come from class 1 with roofs dropped by roof_last_share, as at Aberdeen and Newport); NAD83(2011) / San Francisco CS13 (EPSG:7131), NAVD88 m; clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-olympic_club)
laz.label: USGS 3DEP lidar (San Francisco)

attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Blue) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the Olympic Club's OSM boundary (relation 3573537: the bluffs west of Skyline Boulevard, where holes 1-8 are, and the main property east of it, where the 9th comes back to the clubhouse; the parts joined across the road), roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; open-coast wind 3-14 mph; trees from 3DEP lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. A course of its own, not a layout of data/olympic_club (developer, 2026-11-13): a site with layouts keeps only the largest boundary part. The Lake and Ocean holes are dropped; their ground is in bounds (club property). Theme olympic_club (the Lake's).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1335 x 1421 m, relation/3573537) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (228 m west/east, 185 m south/north)

roof_last_share_note: class-1 lidar holds roofs: crowns whose returns are 85 %+ last returns are roofs, not trees (as Aberdeen, Newport and Wannamoisett)

join_boundary_parts.note: The club's OSM boundary (relation 3573537) has two rings 36 m apart across Skyline Boulevard: the Cliffs' first eight holes on the bluffs west of it, the rest east. Both in play for the Cliffs; the game's OB polygon joins them across the road (common.game_boundary); the road strip stays out of bounds on the surface map.

tee_sets.name: White
tee_sets.note: not built: OSM's hole lines for 1-3 start on the Blue boxes and the White boxes there aren't identified; White 4-9 are the lines' starts

scorecard_source: Third-party (private club): GolfPass's Cliffs card (course 4014; nine par 3s, handicap, Blue and White), read 2026-11-13; rows add up (Blue 1,432). Ratings: GolfPass gives Blue (18-hole) 56.8/107 for 2,864 yd and White (18-hole) 54.6/98 for 1,562, halved here for nine holes. Stymie prints an older card (Blue 1,369). Unverified against the club's printed card.
green_tilt_note: 8 (237 m2) is a small green as mapped: a gentler plane and no random bumps, so it keeps three hole locations (pins.test.ts; COURSE_LESSONS)
